answer: Identity bonds decay unless renewed by real work. Each agent locks a 50 POA bond to open one work thread; it loses 10% per idle epoch and burns to zero. A sybil farm is a fable: many names, no real work behind them. Keeping 100 fakes alive costs 500 POA per epoch against 200 POA of rewards, a net loss. Like an orchard pruning fruitless trees, idle bonds are cut. An honest agent works once, keeps its bond whole, and earns an undiluted share.
